WITH school_rates AS (
  SELECT CDSCode,
         "Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal_count,
         "Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
         CAST("Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / "Enrollment (K-12)" AS free_meal_rate
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda'
),
county_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(free_meal_rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM school_rates
),
top_school AS (
  SELECT sr.CDSCode, sr.free_meal_rate
  FROM school_rates sr
  ORDER BY sr.free_meal_rate DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT t."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter_school,
       t."Low Grade" || '-' || t."High Grade" AS grades_served,
       CASE
         WHEN s.cds IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
         WHEN s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
         WHEN s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
         ELSE 'Above Average'
       END AS sat_performance,
       ts.free_meal_rate - ca.avg_rate AS deviation
FROM top_school ts
JOIN frpm t ON ts.CDSCode = t.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON t.CDSCode = s.cds
CROSS JOIN county_avg ca;
SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS rate FROM frpm WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School' AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0 ORDER BY rate ASC LIMIT 3

WITH max_year AS (
    SELECT MAX(`Academic Year`) AS latest_year 
    FROM frpm 
    WHERE `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 
      AND CDSCode IN (
          SELECT CDSCode FROM schools 
          WHERE County = 'Fresno' AND District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
      )
)
SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State, s.StatusType AS Status,
       strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) AS OpenYear,
       f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment_K12,
       f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPM_Rate,
       CASE 
           WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High FRPM'
           WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 50 THEN 'Medium FRPM'
           ELSE 'Low FRPM'
       END AS FRPM_Category,
       sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS SAT_Rank
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode 
    AND f.`Academic Year` = (SELECT latest_year FROM max_year)
    AND f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' AND s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT frpm."School Name" AS SchoolName, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip, s.MailStreet, s.MailCity, s.MailState, s.MailZip, s.Website, frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS EnrollmentK12, frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS FRPMCountK12, frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS FRPMPercentK12, sat.NumTstTakr, sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite, CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL)*100.0 / NULLIF(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) AS PctGE1500, CASE WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 70 AND (CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL)*100.0 / NULLIF(sat.NumTstTakr, 0)) > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM' WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 30 AND (CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL)*100.0 / NULLIF(sat.NumTstTakr, 0)) < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM' ELSE 'Neither' END AS PerformanceCategory FROM frpm JOIN schools s ON frpm.CDSCode = s.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON frpm.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 AND frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100 ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Phone FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded' AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'

SELECT sc.sname AS "School Name", sc.cname AS "County", sc.dname AS "District", sc.AvgScrRead, sc.AvgScrMath, sc.AvgScrWrite, (sc.AvgScrRead + sc.AvgScrMath + sc.AvgScrWrite) AS total_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sc.AvgScrRead + sc.AvgScrMath + sc.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS sat_rank, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS poverty_level FROM satscores sc JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode JOIN frpm f ON sc.cds = f.CDSCode WHERE sc.rtype = 'S' AND sc.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'F' ORDER BY total_score DESC;

WITH latest_frpm AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" as frpm_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT CDSCode, "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDSCode ORDER BY "Academic Year" DESC) rn
    FROM frpm
  ) tmp
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  s.sname as school_name,
  sat.AvgScrRead,
  sat.AvgScrMath,
  sat.AvgScrWrite,
  (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) AS total_avg,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS overall_rank,
  CASE
    WHEN lf.frpm_pct > 75 THEN 'High'
    WHEN lf.frpm_pct >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS poverty_level,
  CASE
    WHEN (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) >= 1800 THEN 'Excellent'
    WHEN (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 THEN 'Good'
    ELSE 'Needs Improvement'
  END AS performance_category
FROM schools sc
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON sc.CDSCode = sat.cds
INNER JOIN latest_frpm lf ON sc.CDSCode = lf.CDSCode
WHERE sc.Magnet = 1 AND sat.NumTstTakr > 500
ORDER BY total_avg DESC;
SELECT s.Phone FROM schools AS s JOIN satscores AS sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School AS "School Name", s.City AS "City", s.Zip AS "Zip", f.`School Type` AS "School Type", f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS "Enrollment (K-12)", f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS "FRPM Count (K-12)", f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", sat.NumTstTakr AS "NumTstTakr", sat.AvgScrRead AS "AvgScrRead", sat.AvgScrMath AS "AvgScrMath", sat.AvgScrWrite AS "AvgScrWrite", sat.NumGE1500 AS "NumGE1500" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON f.CDSCode = sat.cds ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT satscores.cds) AS num_schools FROM satscores JOIN schools ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 560 AND schools.Charter = 1 AND schools.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT s.School AS school_name, s.Street AS street, s.City AS city, s.Zip AS zip, s.State AS state, sat.AvgScrRead AS avg_read, sat.AvgScrMath AS avg_math, sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_write, frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS total_enrollment, frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_percent, s.Charter AS charter_status FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode WHERE sat.rtype = 'S' AND sat.NumTstTakr > 10 ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
    frpm."County Name" AS "County Name",
    frpm."School Name" AS school_name,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_ages5_17,
    (frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" + frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS total_enrollment,
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS free_meal_percent_k12,
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_percent,
    frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter_yn,
    satscores.AvgScrRead AS avg_read,
    satscores.AvgScrMath AS avg_math,
    satscores.AvgScrWrite AS avg_write,
    (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat_score,
    CASE
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS frpm_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY frpm."County Name" ORDER BY (frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" + frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") DESC) AS enrollment_rank_in_county,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE
            WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 75 THEN 'High'
            WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END ORDER BY (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS sat_rank_in_frpm_category
FROM frpm
LEFT JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE (frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" + frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 500
  AND (
        frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 60
        OR (satscores.NumTstTakr > 0 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 0.3)
      )
ORDER BY "County Name", frpm_category, total_enrollment DESC, total_sat_score DESC;

SELECT schools.School AS school_name, schools.County AS county, schools.District AS district, schools.City AS city, schools.Zip AS zip, frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS free_meal_count, frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_ages_5_17, CAST(frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS free_meal_eligibility_rate, satscores.NumGE1500, satscores.NumTstTakr, CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / satscores.NumTstTakr AS sat_excellence_rate FROM satscores JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active' AND NumTstTakr > 0 AND frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0 AND CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr > 0.3 ORDER BY free_meal_eligibility_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.sname AS school_name, sch.Phone AS contact_number, sch.City AS city, sch.Charter AS charter_status, CASE WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 75 THEN 'High Poverty' WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty' WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 25 THEN 'Low Poverty' ELSE 'Very Low Poverty' END AS poverty_classification FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode JOIN frpm ON s.cds = frpm.CDSCode WHERE s.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT s.NCESSchool FROM frpm f INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode GROUP BY f.CDSCode ORDER BY MAX(f.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]) DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT satscores.dname FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active' AND satscores.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools FROM schools INNER JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Merged' AND schools.County = 'Alameda' AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT sname AS SchoolName, AvgScrWrite, CharterNum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS RankScore FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE satscores.rtype = 'S' AND satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN s.NumTstTakr < 50 THEN 'under 50 testers' WHEN s.NumTstTakr >= 50 AND s.NumTstTakr < 100 THEN '50-100 testers' WHEN s.NumTstTakr >= 100 AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250 THEN '100-250 testers' END AS testing_volume_category, AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS avg_read, AVG(s.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math, AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_write, AVG(s.NumGE1500) AS avg_ge1500, AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS avg_enrollment, AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS avg_frpm_percent FROM frpm f JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds AND s.rtype = 'S' WHERE f."County Name" = 'Fresno' AND f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly funded' AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip, s.Phone, s.Website, sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite, sat.NumGE1500, s.Charter AS charter_status, frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12, frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS eligible_frpm_pct FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds JOIN frpm ON frpm.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active' AND sat.NumTstTakr >= 10 ORDER BY sat.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1

WITH hs AS (
    SELECT f.*, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, s.AvgScrWrite
    FROM frpm f
    LEFT JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
    WHERE f."County Name" = 'Amador'
      AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
      AND f."High Grade" = '12'
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_schools,
    AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS avg_enrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f."Charter School (Y/N)" != 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_count,
    AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS avg_poverty_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f."District Code") AS num_districts,
    AVG(f.AvgScrRead) AS avg_sat_read,
    AVG(f.AvgScrMath) AS avg_sat_math,
    AVG(f.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_write,
    (SELECT f2."School Name" FROM hs AS f2 ORDER BY f2."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 1) AS largest_school_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_poverty_count
FROM hs AS f;

SELECT AVG((CAST("Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) * 100.0) / CAST("Enrollment (K-12)" AS REAL)) AS avg_free_percentage, COUNT(CASE WHEN frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 END) AS charter_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS non_charter_count, AVG(s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_total, COUNT(CASE WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 600 THEN 1 END) AS very_high_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" <= 600 THEN 1 END) AS high_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" <= 500 THEN 1 END) AS moderate_count FROM frpm LEFT JOIN satscores s ON frpm.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE frpm."County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
SELECT s.sname FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE sc.County = 'Contra Costa' ORDER BY s.NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT f."School Name", s.Street FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30;

SELECT DISTINCT satscores.sname FROM satscores JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode WHERE satscores.rtype = 'S' AND (CAST(frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") > 0.1 AND satscores.NumGE1500 > 0
SELECT s.School, f."Educational Option Type" FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.City = 'Riverside' AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT DISTINCT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey' AND f."School Type" LIKE '%High%' AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT s.School AS SchoolName, sat.AvgScrWrite AS WritingScore, s.Phone AS Phone, AVG(sat.AvgScrWrite) OVER () AS OverallAvgWritingScore FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE (s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01') AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT s.School AS name, s.DOCType AS doc_type
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT s.OpenDate FROM frpm AS f JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND f.`High Grade` = '12' ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.City FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode GROUP BY T2.City ORDER BY SUM(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`) ASC LIMIT 5;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC) AS rn
    FROM frpm f
)
SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    s.County AS County,
    s.City AS City,
    s.Zip AS Zip,
    s.State AS State,
    s.Street AS Street,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS EnrollmentK12,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS EnrollmentAges5_17,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS FreeMealCountK12,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS FRPMCountK12,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS FreeEligibleRateK12,
    f.`School Type` AS SchoolType,
    f.`Low Grade` AS LowGrade,
    f.`High Grade` AS HighGrade,
    sa.AvgScrRead,
    sa.AvgScrMath,
    sa.AvgScrWrite,
    sa.NumTstTakr,
    sa.NumGE1500
FROM ranked f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = SUBSTR(f.CDSCode, 2) OR sa.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.rn IN (10, 11)
ORDER BY f.rn;

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, CAST(f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS eligibility_rate, sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite, CAST(sat.NumTstTakr AS REAL) / sat.enroll12 AS participation_rate, CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr AS high_scorer_rate FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE s.SOC = '66' ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT s.Website, f."School Name" FROM frpm f INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT CAST(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE (s.AdmLName1 LIKE '%Gibson%' AND s.AdmFName1 LIKE '%Kacey%') OR (s.AdmLName2 LIKE '%Gibson%' AND s.AdmFName2 LIKE '%Kacey%') OR (s.AdmLName3 LIKE '%Gibson%' AND s.AdmFName3 LIKE '%Kacey%') ORDER BY f.`Academic Year` DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.AdmEmail1 AS administrator_email FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.Charter = 1 ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT (s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1) AS full_name1, (s.AdmFName2 || ' ' || s.AdmLName2) AS full_name2, (s.AdmFName3 || ' ' || s.AdmLName3) AS full_name3 FROM satscores JOIN schools s ON satscores.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE satscores.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT S.Street, S.City, S.Zip, S.State FROM schools AS S INNER JOIN (SELECT cds, CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr AS excellence_rate FROM satscores WHERE rtype = 'S' AND NumTstTakr > 0) AS sat ON S.CDSCode = sat.cds ORDER BY sat.excellence_rate ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.Website FROM schools s JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND sa.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000
SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno' AND T1.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'
SELECT s.Phone FROM satscores AS sc JOIN schools AS s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE sc.rtype = 'S' AND sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND s.District = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT s.School, s.County, sa.AvgScrRead,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND sa.rtype = 'S'
)
SELECT School AS name
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5;
SELECT frpm."School Type" AS "School Type" FROM frpm INNER JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.AvgScrMath, sc.County FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE s.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY (s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sch.City FROM satscores AS s JOIN schools AS sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode WHERE s.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sch.School AS sname, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, s.AvgScrWrite, (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS overall_rank, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_rate, (s.NumTstTakr * 100.0 / s.enroll12) AS participation_rate, AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) OVER (PARTITION BY s.dname) AS dist_avg_write, (s.AvgScrWrite - AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) OVER (PARTITION BY s.dname)) AS writing_diff FROM schools sch JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode AND s.rtype = 'S' JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = sch.CDSCode WHERE (sch.AdmFName1 = 'Vickie' AND sch.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich') OR (sch.AdmFName2 = 'Vickie' AND sch.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich') OR (sch.AdmFName3 = 'Vickie' AND sch.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich')

SELECT DISTINCT s.School FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.DOC = '31' AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" = (SELECT MAX(f2."Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.DOC = '31')
SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_avg FROM schools WHERE County = 'Alameda' AND DOC = '52' AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM schools WHERE County = 'Orange' AND StatusType = 'Merged'
SELECT School, ClosedDate FROM schools WHERE County = (SELECT County FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Closed' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AND StatusType = 'Closed'
SELECT s.School AS `School`, s.MailStreet AS `MailStreet` FROM schools s INNER JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds WHERE sc.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sc.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT T2.MailStreet, T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cds) AS total_schools FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE s.rtype = 'S' AND sc.MailCity = 'Lakeport' AND (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500
SELECT SUM(satscores.NumTstTakr) AS total_test_takers FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.MailCity = 'Fresno';
SELECT School, MailZip FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName3 = 'Atoian')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Colusa') * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Humboldt') AS schools_ratio, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Colusa' AND Charter = 1) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Humboldt' AND Charter = 1) AS charter_ratio, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Colusa' AND f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Humboldt' AND f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS high_frpm_ratio, (SELECT AVG(sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE s.County = 'Colusa') * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE s.County = 'Humboldt') AS avg_sat_ratio, (SELECT SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Colusa') * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Humboldt') AS frpm_total_ratio, (SELECT SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Colusa') * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Humboldt') AS enrollment_ratio
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM schools WHERE MailState = 'CA' AND StatusType = 'Active' AND City = 'San Joaquin';
SELECT s.Phone, s.Ext FROM schools s INNER JOIN (SELECT cds, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rn FROM satscores) ranked ON s.CDSCode = ranked.cds WHERE ranked.rn = 333
SELECT School, Phone, Ext FROM schools WHERE Zip = '95203-3704';

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 = 'Mike Larson' OR AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 = 'Mike Larson' OR AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 = 'Mike Larson' OR AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 = 'Dante Alvarez' OR AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 = 'Dante Alvarez' OR AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 = 'Dante Alvarez');

SELECT s.School AS school_name, f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_k12, f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS free_meal_count, f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS frpm_count, CASE WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High Poverty' WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` BETWEEN 50 AND 75 THEN 'Medium-High Poverty' WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` BETWEEN 25 AND 50 THEN 'Medium-Low Poverty' ELSE 'Low Poverty' END AS poverty_level, sat.NumTstTakr AS sat_test_takers, sat.AvgScrRead AS sat_read_avg, sat.AvgScrMath AS sat_math_avg, sat.AvgScrWrite AS sat_write_avg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC) AS enrollment_rank FROM schools s LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE s.County = 'San Joaquin' AND s.Virtual = 'P' AND s.Charter = 1 ORDER BY enrollment_k12 DESC

SELECT s.School AS school_name, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS eligibility_rate, sat.AvgScrRead AS avg_score_read, sat.AvgScrMath AS avg_score_math, sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_score_write, sat.NumTstTakr AS num_test_takers, sat.NumGE1500 AS num_ge1500, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC) AS size_rank FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds AND sat.rtype = 'S' WHERE s.Charter = 1 AND s.DOC = '52' AND s.City = 'Hickman' AND f."Academic Year" = (SELECT MAX("Academic Year") FROM frpm) ORDER BY enrollment DESC

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
       frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal_count,
       (frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") AS free_meal_percentage,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") ASC) AS rank_in_county,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM schools s2
        JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
        WHERE s2.County = 'Los Angeles'
          AND s2.Charter = 0
          AND (f2."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f2."Enrollment (K-12)") < 0.18) AS total_low_free_meal_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.Charter = 0
  AND (frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") < 0.18;

SELECT AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS FullName, School, City FROM schools WHERE Charter = 1 AND CharterNum = '00D2' AND AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2, School, City FROM schools WHERE Charter = 1 AND CharterNum = '00D2' AND AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3, School, City FROM schools WHERE Charter = 1 AND CharterNum = '00D2' AND AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType != 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio_pct FROM schools WHERE County = 'Santa Clara' AND Charter = 1

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS EnrollmentK12, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPM_Pct, sa.AvgScrRead, sa.AvgScrMath, sa.AvgScrWrite, (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) AS SATTotal, AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) OVER() AS avg_frpm, AVG(sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) OVER() AS avg_sat_total, (f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` - AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) OVER()) AS frpm_diff, ((sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) - AVG(sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) OVER()) AS sat_diff, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` DESC) AS rank_frpm, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS rank_sat FROM schools s LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds WHERE s.County = 'Stanislaus' AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_closure_count FROM schools WHERE City = 'San Francisco' AND District LIKE '%Community College%' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) = 1989
SELECT schools.County FROM schools WHERE schools.SOC = '11' AND schools.ClosedDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31' GROUP BY schools.County ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.NCESDist AS nces_district_id, s.School AS school_name, s.Charter AS charter_status, s.StatusType AS operational_status, s.OpenDate AS opening_date, fr."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment, CASE WHEN fr."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 75 THEN 'High Poverty' WHEN fr."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty' WHEN fr."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 25 THEN 'Low Poverty' ELSE 'Very Low Poverty' END AS poverty_classification, sat.AvgScrRead AS avg_score_read, sat.AvgScrMath AS avg_score_math, sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_score_write, (CAST(sat.AvgScrRead AS REAL) + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 AS overall_avg_sat, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fr."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC) AS enrollment_rank FROM schools s JOIN frpm fr ON s.CDSCode = fr.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Special Schools' AND s.SOC LIKE '3%' ORDER BY fr."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools FROM schools WHERE County = 'Alpine' AND SOCType = 'District Community Day Schools' AND StatusType IN ('Active', 'Closed')
SELECT T1.`District Code` AS district_code FROM frpm T1 INNER JOIN schools T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.City = 'Fresno' AND T2.Magnet = 0;

SELECT SUM(frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS total_enrollment_5_17 FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.EdOpsCode = 'SSS' AND schools.City = 'Fremont' AND frpm.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
SELECT frpm."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040'
SELECT frpm."Low Grade" FROM frpm INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.EdOpsCode = 'SPECON' AND schools.NCESDist = '0613360' ORDER BY frpm."Academic Year" DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT `School Name`, `School Type` FROM frpm WHERE `County Code` = '37' AND `NSLP Provision Status` = 'Breakfast Provision 2'

SELECT s."City" FROM schools s INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s."EILCode" = 'HS' AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Lunch Provision 2' AND f."Low Grade" = '9' AND f."High Grade" = '12' AND s."County" = 'Merced'

SELECT frpm."School Name" AS school_name, CASE WHEN schools.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS charter_status, CASE WHEN (frpm."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / NULLIF(frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) >= 75 THEN 'High Poverty' WHEN (frpm."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / NULLIF(frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) >= 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty' ELSE 'Low Poverty' END AS poverty_level, frpm."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / NULLIF(frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0) AS frpm_percentage, satscores.AvgScrRead, satscores.AvgScrMath, satscores.AvgScrWrite FROM frpm JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE frpm."County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND (CASE WHEN frpm."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 0 WHEN frpm."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN -1 ELSE CAST(frpm."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) END <= 0 AND CASE WHEN frpm."High Grade" = 'K' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(frpm."High Grade" AS INTEGER) END >= 9) ORDER BY frpm_percentage DESC

WITH active_adelanto AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, GSserved
    FROM schools
    WHERE City = 'Adelanto' AND StatusType = 'Active'
),
common_gs AS (
    SELECT GSserved
    FROM active_adelanto
    GROUP BY GSserved
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment,
    AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS avg_frpm_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") > 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS overall_poverty_level,
    AVG(s."AvgScrRead") AS avg_read,
    AVG(s."AvgScrMath") AS avg_math,
    AVG(s."AvgScrWrite") AS avg_write
FROM active_adelanto a
JOIN common_gs g ON a.GSserved = g.GSserved
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON a.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON a.CDSCode = s.cds
GROUP BY g.GSserved

WITH virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.County, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
           f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS is_charter,
           f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct_frpm,
           sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
      AND s.County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
)
SELECT 
    vs.County,
    COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vs.is_charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter,
    SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(vs.is_charter,0) != 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_regular,
    SUM(vs.enrollment) AS total_enrollment,
    AVG(vs.pct_frpm) AS avg_frpm,
    AVG(vs.AvgScrRead) AS avg_read,
    AVG(vs.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math,
    AVG(vs.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_write,
    (SELECT School FROM virtual_schools ORDER BY enrollment DESC LIMIT 1) AS largest_school_name,
    (SELECT enrollment FROM virtual_schools ORDER BY enrollment DESC LIMIT 1) AS largest_school_enrollment
FROM virtual_schools vs
GROUP BY vs.County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.School AS SchoolName, f.`School Type` AS SchoolType, s.Latitude AS Latitude FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM schools);

SELECT s.School, s.City, f.`Low Grade`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
AND s.Latitude = (SELECT MIN(Latitude) FROM schools WHERE State = 'CA')
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools WHERE Longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH k8_magnet AS (
    SELECT f."CDSCode", f."NSLP Provision Status", s."City"
    FROM frpm f
    INNER JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
    WHERE s."Magnet" = 1 AND f."Low Grade" = 'K' AND f."High Grade" = '8'
)
SELECT COALESCE(t.City, 'Number of cities') AS city, t.num_schools,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM k8_magnet WHERE "NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types') AS multiple_provision_count
FROM (
  SELECT City, COUNT(*) AS num_schools FROM k8_magnet GROUP BY City
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, COUNT(DISTINCT City) FROM k8_magnet
) t
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.City IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.num_schools;

WITH names AS (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName1 <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName2 <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName3 <> ''
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM names
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT n.first_name, n.District
FROM names n
JOIN name_counts nc ON n.first_name = nc.first_name
ORDER BY nc.cnt DESC, n.first_name;

SELECT (CAST(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)", f."District Code" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine' OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
SELECT AdmLName1, District, County, School FROM schools WHERE CharterNum = '1740'

WITH valid_schools AS (
  SELECT * FROM schools
  WHERE County = 'San Bernardino' AND City = 'San Bernardino'
    AND DOC = '54' AND SOC = '62'
    AND OpenDate >= '2009-01-01' AND OpenDate <= '2010-12-31'
),
cols AS (SELECT 1 AS col UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3)
SELECT CASE col
         WHEN 1 THEN AdmEmail1
         WHEN 2 THEN AdmEmail2
         WHEN 3 THEN AdmEmail3
       END AS email
FROM valid_schools
CROSS JOIN cols
WHERE CASE col
        WHEN 1 THEN AdmEmail1
        WHEN 2 THEN AdmEmail2
        WHEN 3 THEN AdmEmail3
      END IS NOT NULL;
SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.School FROM satscores AS t INNER JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE t.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id);
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' WHEN AVG(A13) > AVG(A12) THEN '1996' ELSE 'equal' END AS higher_year FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_client_count FROM client WHERE gender = 'F' AND district_id IN ( SELECT d.district_id FROM district d INNER JOIN ( SELECT district_id, A3, A11, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A11 DESC) AS salary_rank FROM district ) ranked ON d.district_id = ranked.district_id WHERE ranked.salary_rank <= 3 AND d.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000 AND d.district_id IN ( SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'F' GROUP BY district_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id AND l.status = 'A' ) )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM client INNER JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'north Bohemia' AND district.A11 > 8000;

WITH oldest_female AS (
  SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS min_birth FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'
),
min_avg_salary AS (
  SELECT MIN(d.A11) AS min_a11
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = (SELECT min_birth FROM oldest_female)
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id,
       ((SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT min_a11 FROM min_avg_salary)) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT min_birth FROM oldest_female)
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT min_a11 FROM min_avg_salary);

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id FROM disp d JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client) AND dist.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT c.gender, CASE WHEN (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) < 30 THEN 'Young' WHEN (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_owners, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense FROM account a INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' GROUP BY c.gender, age_group, d.A3

SELECT c.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date, (SELECT A2 FROM district WHERE district_id = cl.district_id) AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.loan_id END) AS active_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.loan_id END) AS completed_loans, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_transaction_volume, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS num_cards, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) > 0 THEN 'Loans & Cards' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) = 0 THEN 'Loans Only' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) = 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) > 0 THEN 'Cards Only' ELSE 'No Additional Services' END AS service_category FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU') c JOIN client cl ON c.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = c.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = c.account_id LEFT JOIN disp d_card ON d_card.account_id = c.account_id AND d_card.client_id = c.client_id AND d_card.type = 'DISPONENT' LEFT JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d_card.disp_id GROUP BY c.client_id ORDER BY total_transaction_volume DESC

SELECT a.account_id, l.amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND l.amount = (SELECT MIN(l2.amount) FROM loan l2 JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id WHERE strftime('%Y', l2.date) = '1997' AND a2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE')

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, l.amount
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration > 12 AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
)
SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM eligible
WHERE amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM eligible)

SELECT AVG((julianday(a.date) - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25) AS avg_age, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS debt_loans, MIN(strftime('%Y', a.date)) AS earliest_year, MAX(strftime('%Y', a.date)) AS latest_year FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov'
SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM trans WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995' AND date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995')

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id FROM account AS a INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01' AND t.trans_id = (SELECT MAX(t2.trans_id) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id) AND t.balance > 3000

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A4 AS population, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_trans_amount, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, (strftime('%Y', '1994-03-03') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', '1994-03-03') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age_at_card_issue, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CASE WHEN (strftime('%Y', '1994-03-03') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', '1994-03-03') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' ELSE 'Mature borrower' END ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS borrower_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.gender ORDER BY (strftime('%Y', '1994-03-03') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', '1994-03-03') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) DESC) AS age_rank FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp d2 ON c.client_id = d2.client_id JOIN card ca ON d2.disp_id = ca.disp_id AND ca.issued = '1994-03-03' LEFT JOIN account a ON d2.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.client_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT disp.client_id FROM disp JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE card.issued = '1994-03-03') GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.district_id, d.A2, d.A4 ORDER BY c.gender, age_rank;

WITH target_txn AS (
  SELECT account_id FROM trans WHERE amount = 840 AND date = '1998-10-14' LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  a.date AS account_opened,
  CAST(julianday('1998-10-14') - julianday(a.date) AS INTEGER) AS days_open,
  c.gender AS owner_gender,
  CAST((strftime('%Y', '1998-10-14') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', '1998-10-14') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS INTEGER) AS owner_age,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date <= '1998-10-14') AS transactions_up_to_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card ca JOIN disp d ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE d.account_id = target.account_id) AS cards_issued,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = target.account_id AND l.date < '1998-10-14') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS had_loan_before
FROM target_txn target
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = target.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM district d2 WHERE d2.A11 > d.A11 OR (d2.A11 = d.A11 AND d2.district_id < d.district_id)) AS salary_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM district d2 WHERE d2.A12 < d.A12 OR (d2.A12 = d.A12 AND d2.district_id < d.district_id)) AS unemployment_rank, (julianday(l.date) - julianday(a.date)) AS days_open, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE district_id = d.district_id) AS total_clients, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE district_id = d.district_id AND gender = 'M') AS male_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE district_id = d.district_id AND gender = 'F') AS female_count, (SELECT AVG( (julianday('1994-08-25') - julianday(c.birth_date))/365.25 ) FROM client c WHERE c.district_id = d.district_id) AS avg_age, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date < l.date) AS num_transactions, (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date < l.date AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_income FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.date = '1994-08-25' LIMIT 1

WITH client_card AS (SELECT DISTINCT client_id FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21'), client_accounts AS (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM client_card)), max_trans AS (SELECT * FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM client_accounts) ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.date, t.type, t.operation, t.amount, t.balance, t.k_symbol, t.bank, t.account, c.client_id AS client_client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id AS client_district_id, d.district_id AS district_district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM client_accounts)) AS num_loans, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM client_accounts)) AS total_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM client_accounts)) AS num_orders, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM "order" WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM client_accounts)) AS total_order_amount FROM max_trans t JOIN disp dsp ON t.account_id = dsp.account_id JOIN client c ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM client_card);

SELECT c.gender FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY A11 DESC LIMIT 1) AND d.type = 'OWNER' ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC LIMIT 1

WITH biggest_loan AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM loan
  ORDER BY amount DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
CROSS JOIN biggest_loan bl
WHERE t.account_id = bl.account_id
  AND t.date > a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) AS count FROM client JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id AND disp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND client.gender = 'F'
SELECT d.disp_id FROM trans t INNER JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id WHERE t.date = '1998-09-02' AND t.amount = 5100

WITH accounts_base AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'Litomerice' AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996'
),
client_demo AS (
    SELECT ab.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM accounts_base ab
    LEFT JOIN disp d ON ab.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    LEFT JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
),
txn_stats AS (
    SELECT ab.account_id,
           COUNT(t.trans_id) AS num_txns,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals
    FROM accounts_base ab
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON ab.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY ab.account_id
),
loan_stats AS (
    SELECT ab.account_id,
           COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_loans,
           SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amt,
           AVG(l.duration) AS avg_loan_dur,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans
    FROM accounts_base ab
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON ab.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY ab.account_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.account_id) AS total_accounts,
    AVG( (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', cd.birth_date)) - 
         (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', cd.birth_date)) ) AS avg_client_age_years,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_clients,
    COALESCE(SUM(ts.num_txns),0) AS total_transactions,
    COALESCE(SUM(ts.total_deposits),0) AS total_deposits,
    COALESCE(SUM(ts.total_withdrawals),0) AS total_withdrawals,
    COALESCE(SUM(ls.num_loans),0) AS total_loans,
    COALESCE(SUM(ls.total_loan_amt),0) AS total_loan_amount,
    COALESCE(AVG(ls.avg_loan_dur),0) AS avg_loan_duration,
    COALESCE(SUM(ls.good_loans),0) AS good_loans,
    COALESCE(SUM(ls.bad_loans),0) AS bad_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(strftime('%m', ab.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accounts_Q1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(strftime('%m', ab.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accounts_Q2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(strftime('%m', ab.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accounts_Q3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(strftime('%m', ab.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 10 AND 12) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accounts_Q4
FROM accounts_base ab
LEFT JOIN client_demo cd ON ab.account_id = cd.account_id
LEFT JOIN txn_stats ts ON ab.account_id = ts.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_stats ls ON ab.account_id = ls.account_id;

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, a."date" AS account_opened_date, da.A2 AS district_name, da.A3 AS region_name, da.A10 AS unemployment_rate_96, da.A11 AS crimes_96, da.A13 AS urban_ratio, da.A15 AS avg_salary, da.A16 AS entrepreneurs_per_1000, COALESCE(tx.total_credits, 0) AS total_credits, COALESCE(tx.total_debits, 0) AS total_debits, COALESCE(tx.num_trans, 0) AS num_transactions, COALESCE(tx.total_credits, 0) - COALESCE(tx.total_debits, 0) AS net_flow, COALESCE(ln.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count, COALESCE(ln.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount, cd.type AS card_type, cd.issued AS card_issued FROM client ci JOIN disp d ON ci.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN district da ON a.district_id = da.district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_debits, COUNT(*) AS num_trans FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) tx ON a.account_id = tx.account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count, SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM loan GROUP BY account_id) ln ON a.account_id = ln.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE ci.gender = 'F' AND ci.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

SELECT c.birth_date AS birthday, CAST((julianday('1996-01-03') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age_at_loan, d.A2 AS location, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = c.client_id AND type = 'OWNER') AND date < '1996-01-03') AS num_transactions_before_loan, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = c.client_id AND type = 'OWNER') AND date < '1996-01-03') AS total_income, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = c.client_id AND type = 'OWNER') AND date < '1996-01-03') AS total_expenses, CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = c.client_id AND type = 'OWNER') AND date < '1996-01-03') = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = c.client_id AND type = 'OWNER') AND date < '1996-01-03') * 100.0 / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = c.client_id AND type = 'OWNER') AND date < '1996-01-03') END AS expense_income_ratio, (SELECT MIN(balance) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = c.client_id AND type = 'OWNER') AND date < '1996-01-03') AS min_balance, (SELECT MAX(balance) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = c.client_id AND type = 'OWNER') AND date < '1996-01-03') AS max_balance, crd.type AS card_type, crd.issued AS card_issued, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = c.client_id AND type = 'OWNER') AND date < '1996-01-03') AS num_previous_loans FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03' JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN card crd ON dp.disp_id = crd.disp_id LIMIT 1
SELECT a.account_id FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' ORDER BY a.date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT A2 AS district_name, A4 AS inhabitants, COUNT(client.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(CASE WHEN client.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_clients, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN client.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(client.client_id) AS percentage FROM district LEFT JOIN client ON district.district_id = client.district_id WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia' GROUP BY district.district_id ORDER BY A4 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ((late.balance - early.balance) * 100.0 / early.balance) AS increase_rate FROM ( SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = ( SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY loan_id LIMIT 1 ) AND date <= '1993-03-22' ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) early, ( SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = ( SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY loan_id LIMIT 1 ) AND date <= '1998-12-27' ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) late;

SELECT district.A3 AS region, (SUM(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'A' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(loan.amount)) AS pct_amount_A, (COUNT(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'A' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS pct_loans_A, AVG(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'A' THEN (loan.payments * loan.duration - loan.amount) END) AS avg_interest_A, AVG(loan.payments * loan.duration - loan.amount) AS avg_interest_all FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id GROUP BY district.A3

SELECT d.A3 AS region,
       CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END AS size_category,
       100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct,
       (SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN l2.status = 'C' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.amount < 100000) AS overall_avg
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount < 100000
GROUP BY d.A3, size_category;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, d.A10 AS urban_inhabitants_ratio, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_transaction_volume, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_expense, cl.gender AS client_gender, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(cl.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS client_age, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 END) AS defaulted_loan_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Low' END AS risk_assessment FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND a.date < '1994-01-01' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' GROUP BY a.account_id

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency FROM account a INNER JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id INNER JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE a.date >= '1995-01-01' AND a.date <= '2000-12-31' AND dist.A3 = 'east Bohemia'

WITH acct_info AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS open_date, d.A2 AS district_name, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
),
owner_info AS (
  SELECT di.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
  FROM disp di
  JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE di.type = 'OWNER'
),
trans_agg AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type='PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS total_income,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type='VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS total_expense,
         COUNT(*) AS num_transactions
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_agg AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
         SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id, a.open_date, a.district_name,
       o.client_id, o.gender, o.birth_date,
       COALESCE(t.total_income,0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(t.total_expense,0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(t.total_income,0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense,0) AS net_balance,
       COALESCE(t.num_transactions,0) AS num_transactions,
       COALESCE(l.loan_count,0) AS loan_count,
       COALESCE(l.total_loan_amount,0) AS total_loan_amount,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.loan_count,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(t.num_transactions,0) > 10 THEN 'High Activity'
            WHEN COALESCE(l.loan_count,0) > 0 THEN 'Loan Customer'
            WHEN COALESCE(t.num_transactions,0) > 10 THEN 'Active Customer'
            ELSE 'Regular Customer' END AS customer_category,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.total_income,0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense,0) DESC) AS rank
FROM acct_info a
LEFT JOIN owner_info o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_agg t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_agg l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, d.A11 AS avg_salary, d.A12 AS unemployment_95, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, CASE l.status WHEN 'A' THEN 'Running - OK' WHEN 'B' THEN 'Running - Issues' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Finished - No Issues' WHEN 'D' THEN 'Finished - Issues' END AS status_desc, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) AS rank_in_district FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.loan_id = 4990

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region, c.gender, (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id), 0) AS total_income, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id), 0) AS total_expense, CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id), 0) > 0 THEN (COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id), 0)) * 1.0 / COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id), 0) ELSE NULL END AS savings_ratio, CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id), 0) > 1000000 THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id), 0) > 500000 THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS income_classification, (SELECT MAX(l.amount) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 300000) AS max_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 300000) AS loan_count, (SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 300000) AS total_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY (SELECT MAX(l.amount) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 300000) DESC) AS region_rank FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE d.A11 > (SELECT AVG(A11) FROM district) AND (COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id), 0) > 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.amount > 300000) ORDER BY max_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT district_name, avg_salary, loan_id, loan_date, loan_amount, duration, payments, status,
       ROUND((payments * duration - loan_amount) * 100.0 / loan_amount, 2) AS interest_rate,
       client_id, gender, birth_date,
       COALESCE(transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       COALESCE(total_trans_amount, 0.0) AS total_trans_amount
FROM (
    SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, d.A11 AS avg_salary,
           l.loan_id, l.date AS loan_date, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status,
           c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date,
           ta.transaction_count, ta.total_trans_amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN disp dp ON l.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount
        FROM trans t
        GROUP BY t.account_id
    ) ta ON l.account_id = ta.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 60
) sub
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY avg_salary DESC, loan_amount DESC;

SELECT d.A2 AS district, ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A15) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status = 'D'

WITH accounts93 AS ( SELECT a.account_id, STRFTIME('%m', a.date) AS month, d.A2 AS district_name FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993' ), overall AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total93, SUM(CASE WHEN district_name = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decin93 FROM accounts93 ) SELECT a.month, COUNT(a.account_id) AS total_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN a.district_name = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decin_accounts, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.district_name = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.account_id), 2) AS decin_pct, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_trans_amount, CASE WHEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.district_name = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.account_id) > (SELECT 100.0 * decin93 / total93 FROM overall) THEN 'above' WHEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.district_name = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.account_id) = (SELECT 100.0 * decin93 / total93 FROM overall) THEN 'equal' ELSE 'below' END AS comparison FROM accounts93 a LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.month ORDER BY a.month

SELECT a.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2 AS district_name, COALESCE(t.total_transactions, 0) AS total_transactions, COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) AS total_income, COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense, COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS net_cash_flow, COALESCE(l.total_loans, 0) AS total_loans, COALESCE(l.active_loans, 0) AS active_loans, COALESCE(l.completed_loans, 0) AS completed_loans, COALESCE(l.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.total_transactions, 0) DESC) AS rank_transaction_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) DESC) AS rank_cash_flow FROM account a JOIN disp dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id JOIN client c ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense FROM trans GROUP BY account_id ) t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_loans, SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM loan GROUP BY account_id ) l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND dsp.type = 'OWNER' ORDER BY a.account_id

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_account_holders FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' GROUP BY d.district_id ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC LIMIT 9

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%' GROUP BY d.A2 ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_account_holders_no_credit_card FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE dist.A3 = 'south Bohemia' AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.client_id NOT IN (SELECT client_id FROM card JOIN disp d2 ON card.disp_id = d2.disp_id)

SELECT d.A3
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C','D')
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
ORDER BY COUNT(l.loan_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM loan AS l INNER JOIN disp AS d ON l.account_id = d.account_id INNER JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.gender = 'M'
SELECT A3, A2 FROM district WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district)

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population, d.A16 AS crimes_1996, ROUND((d.A16 - d.A15) * 100.0 / d.A15, 2) AS pct_increase, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE district_id = d.district_id) AS total_accounts FROM district d ORDER BY d.A16 DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH qualifying_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
  FROM account a
  WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    AND a.account_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id
      FROM trans t
      WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND t.balance < 0
    )
),
transactions AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, t.balance, t.amount
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN qualifying_accounts q ON t.account_id = q.account_id
  WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND t.balance < 0
),
card_stats AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(c.card_id) AS num_cards,
         SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards
  FROM disp d
  INNER JOIN qualifying_accounts q ON d.account_id = q.account_id
  LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  GROUP BY d.account_id
),
owner_info AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, cl.gender,
         2000 - CAST(strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age
  FROM disp d
  INNER JOIN qualifying_accounts q ON d.account_id = q.account_id
  INNER JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(balance) FROM transactions) AS avg_negative_balance,
  (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM transactions) AS max_withdrawal_amount,
  (SELECT AVG(num_cards) FROM card_stats) AS avg_cards_per_account,
  (SELECT SUM(gold_cards) FROM card_stats) AS total_gold_cards,
  (SELECT AVG(age) FROM owner_info) AS avg_owner_age,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owner_info WHERE gender = 'M') AS male_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owner_info WHERE gender = 'F') AS female_count;

SELECT COUNT(loan_id) AS cnt FROM loan INNER JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND loan.date >= '1995-01-01' AND loan.date <= '1997-12-31' AND loan.amount >= 250000

WITH loan_owners AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, l.amount, l.payments, l.duration, a.account_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.district_id = 1 AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')
),
owner_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        gender,
        birth_date,
        account_id,
        amount - payments * duration AS remaining_debt,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = lo.account_id) AS trans_count,
        (SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = lo.account_id ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_balance,
        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card WHERE disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = lo.client_id AND type = 'OWNER')) AS has_card
    FROM loan_owners lo
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS num_owners,
    AVG(remaining_debt) AS avg_remaining_debt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN client_id END) AS male_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN client_id END) AS female_count,
    AVG( (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', birth_date)) ) AS avg_age,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_card THEN client_id END) AS num_with_card,
    AVG(trans_count) AS avg_trans_count,
    AVG(latest_balance) AS avg_balance
FROM owner_stats;

WITH target_district AS ( SELECT district_id, A15 FROM district ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1 ), male_clients AS ( SELECT client_id, birth_date FROM client WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM target_district) AND gender = 'M' ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM male_clients) AS total_count, (SELECT A15 FROM target_district) AS crime_count_1995, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) FROM male_clients mc JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = mc.client_id) AS total_accounts, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) FROM male_clients mc JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = mc.client_id JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id) AS total_loans, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) FROM male_clients mc JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = mc.client_id JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id) AS total_cards, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(SUM(disp_count) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) END FROM (SELECT mc.client_id, COUNT(d.disp_id) AS disp_count FROM male_clients mc LEFT JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = mc.client_id GROUP BY mc.client_id) sub) AS avg_disp_per_client, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mc.client_id) FROM male_clients mc JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = mc.client_id JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id) AS clients_with_loans, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM male_clients WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date))) < 30) AS young, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM male_clients WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date))) BETWEEN 30 AND 50) AS middle_aged, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM male_clients WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date))) > 50) AS senior

WITH gold_owner_accounts AS (SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id FROM card JOIN disp d ON card.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'), account_avg_balance AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000), eligible_clients AS (SELECT DISTINCT goa.client_id, aab.avg_bal FROM gold_owner_accounts goa JOIN account_avg_balance aab ON goa.account_id = aab.account_id) SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT ec.client_id) AS client_count, AVG(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS avg_age, AVG(ec.avg_bal) AS avg_balance FROM eligible_clients ec JOIN client c ON ec.client_id = c.client_id GROUP BY c.gender;

WITH accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.A3 = 'Pisek'
),
per_account_trans_count AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS num_trans
  FROM accounts a
  LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id
),
per_account_max_balance AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, MAX(t.balance) AS max_bal
  FROM accounts a
  LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id
),
total_cards AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  WHERE d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts)
),
loan_summary AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS total_loans
  FROM loan
  WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts) AS total_accounts,
  (SELECT AVG(num_trans) FROM per_account_trans_count) AS avg_transactions_per_account,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS total_deposits,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS total_withdrawals,
  (SELECT AVG(max_bal) FROM per_account_max_balance) AS avg_max_balance,
  (SELECT total_cards FROM total_cards) AS total_credit_cards,
  (SELECT total_loans FROM loan_summary) AS total_loans,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT total_loan_amount FROM loan_summary) != 0 THEN
    100.0 * (SELECT active_loan_amount FROM loan_summary) / (SELECT total_loan_amount FROM loan_summary)
    ELSE 0 END AS pct_active_loan_amounts,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
   FROM disp d
   WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
     AND d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts)) AS unique_owners
SELECT DISTINCT d.A3 AS district FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.amount > 10000 AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997'
SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

WITH gold_accounts AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS gold_card_count
  FROM disp d
  JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
  GROUP BY d.account_id
),
owner_district AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, cl.client_id, cl.district_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
location AS (
  SELECT od.account_id,
         MAX(dst.A2) AS district_A2,
         MAX(dst.A3) AS district_A3
  FROM owner_district od
  JOIN district dst ON od.district_id = dst.district_id
  GROUP BY od.account_id
),
transactions AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS total_trans,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS income_trans,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expense_trans,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense_amount,
         MIN(balance) AS min_balance,
         MAX(balance) AS max_balance,
         AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
loans AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT 
  GA.account_id,
  GA.gold_card_count,
  L.district_A2,
  L.district_A3,
  COALESCE(T.total_trans, 0) AS total_transactions,
  COALESCE(T.income_trans, 0) AS income_transactions,
  COALESCE(T.expense_trans, 0) AS expense_transactions,
  COALESCE(T.total_income_amount, 0) AS total_income_amount,
  COALESCE(T.total_expense_amount, 0) AS total_expense_amount,
  T.min_balance,
  T.max_balance,
  T.avg_balance,
  COALESCE(LN.good_loans, 0) AS good_loans,
  COALESCE(LN.bad_loans, 0) AS bad_loans,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T.avg_balance DESC) AS rank
FROM gold_accounts GA
LEFT JOIN location L ON GA.account_id = L.account_id
LEFT JOIN transactions T ON GA.account_id = T.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans LN ON GA.account_id = LN.account_id
ORDER BY rank;

SELECT d.A3 AS region, d.A2 AS district, cl.gender, c.type AS card_type, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_txn_amount, SUM(t.amount) AS total_spending, d.A11 AS avg_salary, (1.0 * SUM(t.amount) / d.A11) AS spending_salary_ratio, (1.0 * AVG(t.amount) / d.A11) AS avg_txn_salary_ratio FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON t.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id WHERE strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998' AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' GROUP BY d.A3, d.A2, cl.gender, c.type

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM trans t
