JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (
    SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1998'
  );

WITH client_accounts AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.account_id, d.disp_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    AND (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) - 
         (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))) >= 18
),
client_loans AS (
    SELECT ca.client_id,
           ca.district_id,
           SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 'Default' ELSE 'Good Standing' END AS loan_status
    FROM client_accounts ca
    INNER JOIN loan l ON ca.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY ca.client_id
),
client_cards AS (
    SELECT ca.client_id,
           (SELECT c.type FROM card c JOIN disp d2 ON c.disp_id = d2.disp_id 
            WHERE d2.client_id = ca.client_id AND d2.type = 'OWNER'
            ORDER BY c.issued DESC LIMIT 1) AS card_type,
           (SELECT c.issued FROM card c JOIN disp d2 ON c.disp_id = d2.disp_id 
            WHERE d2.client_id = ca.client_id AND d2.type = 'OWNER'
            ORDER BY c.issued DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_card_issued
    FROM client_accounts ca
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card c JOIN disp d2 ON c.disp_id = d2.disp_id 
                  WHERE d2.client_id = ca.client_id AND d2.type = 'OWNER')
    GROUP BY ca.client_id
),
client_transactions AS (
    SELECT ca.client_id,
           COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM client_accounts ca
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON ca.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY ca.client_id
)
SELECT ranked.client_id,
       ranked.card_type,
       ranked.last_card_issued,
       ranked.loan_status,
       ranked.total_loan_amount,
       ranked.transaction_count,
       ranked.total_income,
       ranked.total_expense,
       ranked.savings_rate,
       ranked.regional_loan_rank
FROM (
    SELECT cl.client_id,
           cc.card_type,
           cc.last_card_issued,
           cl.loan_status,
           cl.total_loan_amount,
           ct.transaction_count,
           ct.total_income,
           ct.total_expense,
           CASE WHEN ct.total_income > 0 THEN (ct.total_income - ct.total_expense) * 100.0 / ct.total_income ELSE NULL END AS savings_rate,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cl.district_id ORDER BY cl.total_loan_amount DESC) AS regional_loan_rank
    FROM client_loans cl
    JOIN client_cards cc ON cl.client_id = cc.client_id
    LEFT JOIN client_transactions ct ON cl.client_id = ct.client_id
) AS ranked
ORDER BY ranked.total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT sub.district, CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', sub.birth_date) AS INTEGER) > 1980 THEN 'Young' WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', sub.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1960 AND 1980 THEN 'Middle-aged' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group, AVG(sub.tx_cnt) AS avg_tx_count, AVG(sub.net_bal) AS avg_net_balance, AVG(sub.total_loan_amt) AS avg_loan_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(sub.total_loans) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(sub.active_loans) AS REAL) / SUM(sub.total_loans) ELSE 0 END AS active_loan_rate FROM ( SELECT c.birth_date, d.A2 AS district, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS tx_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS net_bal, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amt, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 END) AS active_loans FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A3 = 'south Bohemia' GROUP BY c.client_id, d.A2, c.birth_date ) sub GROUP BY sub.district, age_group ORDER BY sub.district, age_group;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id),0) AS trans_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) AS total_trans_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id),0) AS loan_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount),0) AS total_loan_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'bad' ELSE 'good' END AS credit_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) DESC, AVG(t.balance) DESC) AS priority_rank FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dst ON a.district_id = dst.district_id AND dst.A2 = 'Tabor' LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date

SELECT DISTINCT d.type FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE dist.A11 > 8000 AND dist.A11 <= 9000 AND d.type != 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans AS t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.A3 = 'north Bohemia' AND t.bank = 'AB'

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_withdrawals, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal_amount, d.A4 AS population, d.A12 AS unemployment_rate_95, CASE WHEN d.A12 > 2.0 THEN 'High' WHEN d.A12 >= 1.0 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS unemployment_category, SUM(t.amount) * 1.0 / d.A4 AS withdrawal_per_capita, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS amount_rank FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A4, d.A12 ORDER BY amount_rank
SELECT AVG(A15) AS avg_crimes_1995 FROM district WHERE A15 > 4000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account WHERE account.district_id = district.district_id AND date >= '1997-01-01')

WITH qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, c.district_id, c.client_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id AND ca.type = 'classic'
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
),
account_balances AS (
    SELECT qa.account_id, qa.district_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) -
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS balance
    FROM qualifying_accounts qa
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON qa.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY qa.account_id, qa.district_id
)
SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT qa2.client_id) FROM qualifying_accounts qa2 WHERE qa2.district_id = d.district_id) AS num_classic_card_owners,
       (SELECT AVG(l.amount) FROM qualifying_accounts qa2 JOIN loan l ON qa2.account_id = l.account_id WHERE qa2.district_id = d.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount,
       (SELECT AVG(balance) FROM account_balances WHERE district_id = d.district_id) AS avg_account_balance,
       (SELECT AVG(cl.loan_perf) FROM (
            SELECT qa2.client_id, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS loan_perf
            FROM qualifying_accounts qa2 LEFT JOIN loan l ON qa2.account_id = l.account_id
            WHERE qa2.district_id = d.district_id
            GROUP BY qa2.client_id
       ) cl) AS avg_loan_performance,
       d.A11 AS district_salary,
       d.A13 AS unemployment_rate
FROM district d
ORDER BY d.district_id

SELECT CASE WHEN (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y',c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d',c.birth_date)) < 30 THEN 'Young' WHEN (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y',c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d',c.birth_date)) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS num_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS num_loans, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount),0) AS total_loan_amount, COALESCE(AVG(l.amount),0) AS avg_loan_amount, COALESCE(AVG(l.payments),0) AS avg_loan_payments, COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 END) AS good_loans, COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 END) AS bad_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS num_income_trans, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS num_expense_trans, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM'),0) AS total_income_amount, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'),0) AS total_expense_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS num_cards FROM client c LEFT JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND c.district_id = 1 GROUP BY age_group ORDER BY CASE age_group WHEN 'Young' THEN 1 WHEN 'Middle-aged' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

SELECT COALESCE(d.A3, 'Overall') AS region, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pre_1998, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage FROM card c JOIN disp ON c.disp_id = disp.disp_id JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.type = 'gold' GROUP BY d.A3 UNION ALL SELECT 'Overall', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) FROM card WHERE type = 'gold' ORDER BY region;

WITH max_loan AS (SELECT * FROM loan WHERE amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT  c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, CASE  WHEN (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 30 THEN 'Young'  WHEN (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'  ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_category, d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A11 AS average_salary, d.A12 AS unemployment_rate, CASE WHEN d.A12 > 1.0 THEN 'High Unemployment' ELSE 'Normal' END AS economic_status, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_income, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_expense, CASE  WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') = 0 THEN NULL  ELSE ROUND( ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ')) * 100.0 / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM'), 2) END AS savings_rate, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.date AS loan_date, l.duration, l.payments AS monthly_payment, l.status AS loan_status, (SELECT t2.date FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id ORDER BY t2.date DESC, t2.trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_transaction_date, (SELECT t2.amount FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id ORDER BY t2.date DESC, t2.trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_transaction_amount FROM max_loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS district_name, d.A15 AS crime_1995, d.A16 AS crime_1996, ROUND(CASE WHEN d.A15 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (d.A16 - d.A15) * 100.0 / d.A15 END, 2) AS pct_change, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.A16 DESC) AS crime_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id) AS loan_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id) AS trans_count, (SELECT AVG(d2.A16) FROM district d2) AS avg_crime_all, d.A16 - (SELECT AVG(d2.A16) FROM district d2) AS diff_from_avg FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.account_id = 532;

WITH target_account AS (
  SELECT account_id FROM `order` WHERE order_id = 33333
),
acct_info AS (
  SELECT account_id, district_id FROM account WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account)
),
district_rank AS (
  SELECT district_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A13 DESC) AS salary_rank FROM district
),
trans_history AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credits,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_debits,
         (SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = ta.account_id ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account)
  GROUP BY account_id
),
owner AS (
  SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date
  FROM client
  JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
  WHERE disp.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account) AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
  LIMIT 1
),
loan_status AS (
  SELECT coalesce(GROUP_CONCAT(status, ', '), '') AS loan_status
  FROM loan
  WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT account_id FROM target_account) AS account_id,
  (SELECT district_id FROM acct_info) AS district_id,
  (SELECT salary_rank FROM district_rank WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM acct_info)) AS salary_rank,
  (SELECT transaction_count FROM trans_history) AS transaction_count,
  (SELECT total_credits FROM trans_history) AS total_credits,
  (SELECT total_debits FROM trans_history) AS total_debits,
  (SELECT latest_balance FROM trans_history) AS latest_balance,
  (SELECT client_id FROM owner) AS owner_client_id,
  (SELECT gender FROM owner) AS owner_gender,
  (SELECT birth_date FROM owner) AS owner_birth_date,
  (SELECT loan_status FROM loan_status) AS loan_status,
  (SELECT bank_to FROM `order` WHERE order_id=33333) AS order_bank_to,
  (SELECT account_to FROM `order` WHERE order_id=33333) AS order_account_to,
  (SELECT amount FROM `order` WHERE order_id=33333) AS order_amount,
  (SELECT k_symbol FROM `order` WHERE order_id=33333) AS order_k_symbol;

SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.date, t.type, t.operation, t.amount, t.balance, t.k_symbol, t.bank, t.account FROM trans t JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.client_id = 3356 AND t.operation = 'VYBER';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS cnt FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND l.amount < 200000;

SELECT cl.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date, cl.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, d.A11 AS average_salary, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM district d2 WHERE d2.A11 > d.A11) AS salary_rank, ca.card_id, ca.type AS card_type, ca.issued, CASE WHEN ca.type = 'gold' THEN 'Premium' WHEN ca.type = 'classic' AND date(ca.issued, '+5 years') <= date('now') THEN 'Long-term Classic' ELSE 'Standard' END AS customer_segment, COALESCE(tx.total_income, 0) AS total_income, COALESCE(tx.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense, COALESCE(tx.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count, COALESCE(ln.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count FROM client cl JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = 13539) ) tx ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = 13539) ) ln ON 1=1 WHERE cl.client_id = 13539

WITH client_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.A3 AS region
    FROM disp dp
    JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE dp.client_id = 3541 AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
)
SELECT ca.account_id,
       ca.region,
       COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE loan.account_id = ca.account_id), 0) AS loan_count,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM loan WHERE loan.account_id = ca.account_id), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(status, ', ') FROM loan WHERE loan.account_id = ca.account_id) AS loan_statuses,
       COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
       COALESCE(t.trans_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c2 JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id WHERE d2.A3 = ca.region AND c2.client_id != 3541) AS other_clients_in_region
FROM client_accounts ca
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
           COUNT(*) AS trans_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
) t ON ca.account_id = t.account_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC

SELECT d.A2 AS district FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.status = 'A' GROUP BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.gender AS client_gender, c.birth_date AS client_birth_date, d.A2 AS district_name, o.order_id, o.bank_to, o.account_to, o.amount AS order_amount, o.k_symbol, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(l.status, ', ') FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = o.account_id) AS loan_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card cd JOIN disp dp ON cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id) AS num_credit_cards, (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = o.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_income, (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = o.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_expense, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END), 0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = o.account_id) AS net_balance FROM "order" o JOIN disp dp ON o.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE o.order_id = 32423;

SELECT T.trans_id, T.account_id, T.date, T.type, T.operation, T.amount, T.balance, T.k_symbol, T.bank, T.account FROM trans T INNER JOIN account A ON T.account_id = A.account_id WHERE A.district_id = 5

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS total_accounts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS total_transactions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS incoming_transactions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS outgoing_transactions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS total_loans, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND l.status = 'A') AS good_loans, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND l.status = 'B') AS bad_loans, (SELECT AVG(t.balance) FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS average_balance, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) FROM client cl JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS total_clients, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) FROM client cl JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND cl.gender = 'M') AS male_clients, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) FROM client cl JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND cl.gender = 'F') AS female_clients
SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id FROM card c JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE c.type = 'junior' AND c.issued >= '1997-01-01'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dst ON a.district_id = dst.district_id WHERE dst.A11 > 10000;

SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) = '1997' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) = '1996' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) = '1996' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS growth_rate FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) IN ('1996', '1997');
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM trans WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND date > '1995-12-31'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS difference FROM district
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM disp WHERE type IN ('OWNER', 'DISPONENT') AND account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(trans_id) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3 AND k_symbol = 'VYBER') AS statement_request_count, (SELECT k_symbol FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3 AND type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY k_symbol HAVING SUM(amount) = 3539) AS debiting_purpose;
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year FROM disp d JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE d.account_id = 130 AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT dist.A3 AS region, a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts, dist.A11 AS avg_district_salary, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 0 THEN CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) ELSE 0 END AS loan_adoption_rate, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_activity, SUM(lb.balance) AS total_balances FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, balance FROM (SELECT account_id, balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC) as rn FROM trans) WHERE rn = 1) lb ON a.account_id = lb.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' GROUP BY a.district_id, dist.A3, dist.A11 ORDER BY region, district_id

SELECT l.amount AS debt_amount, l.status AS payment_status FROM loan l JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.client_id = 992 AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT t.balance, c.gender FROM trans t INNER JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id INNER JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.client_id = 4 AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND t.trans_id = 851

SELECT c.gender, c.birth_date, card.type AS credit_card_type, card.issued AS card_issued, CASE WHEN card.type = 'gold' THEN 'Premium Customer' WHEN card.type = 'classic' THEN 'Regular Customer' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS customer_status, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d2.account_id) FROM disp d2 WHERE d2.client_id = c.client_id AND d2.type = 'OWNER') AS total_accounts_owned, 365 * (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', card.issued)) + 30 * (strftime('%m', 'now') - strftime('%m', card.issued)) + (strftime('%d', 'now') - strftime('%d', card.issued)) AS days_held_most_recent FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN card ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE c.client_id = 9 ORDER BY card.issued DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid FROM trans t JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.client_id = 617 AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, a.account_id FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE dist.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND c.birth_date BETWEEN '1983-01-01' AND '1987-12-31'

SELECT c.client_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.payments, l.duration, l.payments * l.duration AS total_payments, (l.payments * l.duration) - l.amount AS interest_paid, l.status, d.A3 AS location, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = l.account_id) AS transaction_activity, CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND type = 'PRIJEM') > 2 * l.amount THEN 'High' WHEN (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND type = 'PRIJEM') > l.amount THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS income_category, (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' ORDER BY l.amount DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_customers FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976' AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND o.amount > 4000;

SELECT c.year, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type='OWNER' JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district dis ON a.district_id = dis.district_id WHERE dis.A3 = 'Beroun' AND a.date >= '1997-01-01' AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = c.year AND cl.gender = 'M') AS male_owners, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type='OWNER' JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district dis ON a.district_id = dis.district_id WHERE dis.A3 = 'Beroun' AND a.date >= '1997-01-01' AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = c.year AND cl.gender = 'F') AS female_owners, (SELECT AVG((julianday(a.date) - julianday(cl.birth_date))/365.25) FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type='OWNER' JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district dis ON a.district_id = dis.district_id WHERE dis.A3 = 'Beroun' AND a.date >= '1997-01-01' AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = c.year) AS avg_age, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dis ON a.district_id = dis.district_id WHERE dis.A3 = 'Beroun' AND a.date >= '1997-01-01' AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = c.year AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_income, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dis ON a.district_id = dis.district_id WHERE dis.A3 = 'Beroun' AND a.date >= '1997-01-01' AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = c.year AND t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_expenses, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(l.loan_id) ELSE NULL END FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dis ON a.district_id = dis.district_id WHERE dis.A3 = 'Beroun' AND a.date >= '1997-01-01' AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = c.year) AS loan_success_rate, c.type AS card_type, c.card_count AS total_cards FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y', a.date) AS year, cd.type, COUNT(*) AS card_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp disp2 ON a.account_id = disp2.account_id JOIN card cd ON disp2.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.A3 = 'Beroun' AND a.date >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY strftime('%Y', a.date), cd.type) c ORDER BY c.year, c.type;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS count FROM client AS cl INNER JOIN disp AS d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id INNER JOIN card AS c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE cl.gender = 'F' AND c.type = 'junior';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS proportion FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE dist.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

WITH weekly_owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
owner_transactions AS (
  SELECT wo.client_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS tx_count
  FROM weekly_owners wo
  LEFT JOIN disp d2 ON wo.client_id = d2.client_id AND d2.type = 'OWNER'
  LEFT JOIN trans t ON d2.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY wo.client_id
),
owner_total_amount AS (
  SELECT wo.client_id, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) AS total_amt
  FROM weekly_owners wo
  LEFT JOIN disp d2 ON wo.client_id = d2.client_id AND d2.type = 'OWNER'
  LEFT JOIN trans t ON d2.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY wo.client_id
),
owner_cards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT wo.client_id
  FROM weekly_owners wo
  JOIN disp d2 ON wo.client_id = d2.client_id AND d2.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d2.disp_id
),
weekly_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id
  FROM account a
  WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
latest_balance AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, t.balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
  ) recent ON t.account_id = recent.account_id AND t.date = recent.max_date
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM weekly_owners) AS num_owners,
  (SELECT AVG(CAST(tx_count AS REAL)) FROM owner_transactions) AS avg_tx,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owner_cards) AS num_with_card,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owner_total_amount WHERE total_amt > 10000) AS high_vol,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cl.district_id)
   FROM client cl
   JOIN weekly_owners wo ON cl.client_id = wo.client_id) AS num_districts,
  (SELECT AVG(lb.balance)
   FROM weekly_accounts wa
   JOIN latest_balance lb ON wa.account_id = lb.account_id) AS avg_balance;

SELECT a.account_id, l.loan_id, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration AS loan_duration, l.date AS loan_date, t.trans_id, t.date AS trans_date, t.type AS trans_type, t.amount AS trans_amount, t.balance AS trans_balance, cd.card_id, cd.type AS card_type, cd.issued AS card_issued, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id, o.order_id, o.bank_to, o.account_to, o.amount AS order_amount, o.k_symbol FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN (SELECT MIN(l2.amount) as min_amt FROM loan l2 JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id WHERE l2.duration > 24 AND a2.date < '1997-01-01') min_q ON l.amount = min_q.min_amt JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.duration > 24 AND a.date < '1997-01-01' ORDER BY a.account_id, t.trans_id, cd.card_id, o.order_id

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id FROM client cli JOIN disp d ON cli.client_id = d.client_id JOIN district dis ON cli.district_id = dis.district_id WHERE cli.gender = 'F' AND cli.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(c.birth_date) FROM client c WHERE c.gender = 'F') AND dis.A11 = (SELECT MIN(dis2.A11) FROM client c2 JOIN district dis2 ON c2.district_id = dis2.district_id WHERE c2.gender = 'F')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS total_clients, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND c.gender = 'M') AS male_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND c.gender = 'F') AS female_count, (SELECT d2.A2 FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia' GROUP BY c.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS most_common_district_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disp WHERE client_id IN (SELECT c.client_id FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia')) AS total_accounts, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT d2.account_id FROM disp d2 WHERE d2.client_id IN (SELECT c.client_id FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'))) AS total_transactions, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT d2.account_id FROM disp d2 WHERE d2.client_id IN (SELECT c.client_id FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia')) AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_income, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT d2.account_id FROM disp d2 WHERE d2.client_id IN (SELECT c.client_id FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia')) AND t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_expense, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT d2.account_id FROM disp d2 WHERE d2.client_id IN (SELECT c.client_id FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'))) AS total_loans, (SELECT AVG(l.amount) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT d2.account_id FROM disp d2 WHERE d2.client_id IN (SELECT c.client_id FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'))) AS avg_loan_amount, (SELECT AVG(l.duration) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT d2.account_id FROM disp d2 WHERE d2.client_id IN (SELECT c.client_id FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'))) AS avg_loan_duration

WITH cte AS ( SELECT l.*, dt.A10, dt.A11, dt.A12, dt.A13, dt.A14, dt.A15, dt.A16 FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id WHERE l.duration = 24 AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY l.amount DESC LIMIT 50 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, AVG(amount) AS avg_loan_amount, AVG(payments) AS avg_monthly_payment, AVG(payments * 24) AS avg_total_paid, AVG(((payments * 24 - amount) * 1.0 / amount) / 2.0) AS avg_annual_interest_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_A_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_B_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_C_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_D_count, AVG(A10) AS avg_A10, AVG(A11) AS avg_A11, AVG(A12) AS avg_A12, AVG(A13) AS avg_A13, AVG(A14) AS avg_A14, AVG(A15) AS avg_A15, AVG(A16) AS avg_A16 FROM cte
SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.status IN ('C','D') AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
SELECT DISTINCT cl.client_id AS ID, d.A3 AS district FROM client cl JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS age FROM client c INNER JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id INNER JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE ca.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'

WITH most_common AS (
  SELECT bond_type
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY bond_type
  ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common)) AS total_occurrences,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common)) AS num_molecules,
  (SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common)) AS avg_bonds_per_molecule,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MIN(a1.element, a2.element) || '-' || MAX(a1.element, a2.element))
   FROM bond b
   JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
   JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
   JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
   WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common)
  ) AS unique_element_pairs,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END ORDER BY m.label)
   FROM molecule m
   WHERE m.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common))
  ) AS labels;

WITH eligible_molecules AS ( SELECT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 'cl' WHERE m.label = '-' GROUP BY m.molecule_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_molecules, AVG(cl_count) AS avg_cl_atoms, MAX(cl_count) AS max_cl_atoms, AVG(bond_count) AS avg_bonds, SUM(CASE WHEN single_bond_count > double_bond_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_single_gt_double, AVG(cl_bond_count) AS avg_cl_bonds FROM ( SELECT em.molecule_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = em.molecule_id AND a.element = 'cl') AS cl_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = em.molecule_id) AS bond_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = em.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '-') AS single_bond_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = em.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '=') AS double_bond_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id) AND a.element = 'cl' WHERE a.molecule_id = em.molecule_id) AS cl_bond_count FROM eligible_molecules em ) sub

SELECT AVG(o_count) AS avg_oxygen_count FROM (SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 'o') AS o_count FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = '-') GROUP BY a.molecule_id) sub

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS avg_single_bonds FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_non_carcinogenic FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'na' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT m.molecule_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND lower(a.element) = 'c') AS carbon_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND lower(a.element) = 'n') AS nitrogen_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#' AND lower(a1.element) = 'n' AND lower(a2.element) = 'n') AS n2_triple, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#' AND (lower(a1.element) = 'c' OR lower(a2.element) = 'c')) AS c_containing_triple, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#') AS num_triple_bonds FROM molecule m WHERE m.label = '+' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#') ORDER BY num_triple_bonds
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#'

WITH eligible_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM (
    SELECT molecule_id FROM bond
    UNION
    SELECT molecule_id FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  )
),
atom_connections AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id, COUNT(c.bond_id) AS conn_count
  FROM atom a
  LEFT JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  WHERE a.element != 'br'
  AND a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM eligible_molecules)
  GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.molecule_id
)
SELECT AVG(conn_count) AS average_connections, SUM(CASE WHEN conn_count > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_high_connections
FROM atom_connections;

SELECT AVG(num_atoms) AS avg_atoms,
       AVG(num_carbon) AS avg_carbon,
       AVG(num_bonds) AS avg_bonds,
       AVG(num_double_bonds) AS avg_double_bonds,
       AVG(connected_atoms) AS avg_connected_atoms,
       AVG(c_c_ratio) AS avg_c_c_ratio
FROM (
    SELECT t.molecule_id, t.num_atoms, t.num_carbon, t.num_bonds, t.num_double_bonds, t.connected_atoms,
           COALESCE(CAST(t.carbon_carbon_bonds AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.num_bonds, 0), 0) AS c_c_ratio
    FROM (
        SELECT m.molecule_id,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS num_atoms,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'c') AS num_carbon,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS num_bonds,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '=') AS num_double_bonds,
               (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id) FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS connected_atoms,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_id IN 
                    (SELECT c.bond_id FROM connected c 
                     JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id AND a1.element = 'c'
                     JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id AND a2.element = 'c'
                     WHERE a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id)) AS carbon_carbon_bonds
        FROM molecule m
        WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
          AND m.label = '+'
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND (a.element = 'c' OR a.element = 'h'))
    ) AS t
) AS sub

SELECT m.molecule_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND element = 'c') AS carbon_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND element = 'cl') AS chlorine_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND bond_type = '=') AS double_bond_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.atom_id = c.atom_id AND a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a2 WHERE a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 AND a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id)) AS connection_count FROM molecule m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND element = 'c') ORDER BY carbon_count DESC, atom_count DESC

SELECT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9' UNION SELECT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

WITH element_atoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element, a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
        WHERE b.bond_type = '=' AND (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
    )
),
molecule_examples AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ea.element, m.molecule_id, m.label,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ea.element ORDER BY m.molecule_id) AS rn
    FROM element_atoms ea
    JOIN molecule m ON ea.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    e.element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ea.atom_id) AS atom_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ea.molecule_id) AS molecule_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT ea.atom_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom), 2) AS percentage,
    (SELECT group_concat(me.molecule_id || ' (' || me.label || ')', ', ')
     FROM molecule_examples me
     WHERE me.element = e.element AND me.rn <= 3) AS example_molecules
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT element FROM element_atoms) e
LEFT JOIN element_atoms ea ON e.element = ea.element
GROUP BY e.element

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'h' AND m.label = dl.label) AS total_hydrogen_atoms, (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = dl.label) FROM molecule m2 JOIN atom a2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id WHERE a2.element = 'h' AND m2.label = dl.label) AS avg_hydrogen_per_molecule, (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = dl.label) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m3 ON b.molecule_id = m3.molecule_id WHERE m3.label = dl.label) AS avg_bonds_per_molecule, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m4 ON b.molecule_id = m4.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m4.label = dl.label) AS total_single_bonds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m5 ON b.molecule_id = m5.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '=' AND m5.label = dl.label) AS total_double_bonds FROM (SELECT label FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'h' GROUP BY m.label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS dl

SELECT b.bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.element != 'cl' THEN a1.atom_id WHEN a2.element != 'cl' THEN a2.atom_id END) AS non_cl_atoms FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' GROUP BY b.bond_type ORDER BY frequency DESC

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element AS atom1_element, a2.element AS atom2_element FROM connected JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id JOIN atom a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id FROM atom AS a INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE m.label = '-'
SELECT a.element FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' GROUP BY a.element ORDER BY COUNT(a.element) ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.bond_type FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE (T2.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20') OR (T2.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8')
SELECT DISTINCT m.label FROM molecule m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a JOIN molecule m2 ON a.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'sn' AND m2.label = m.label)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS count FROM atom a WHERE a.element IN ('i','s') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '-')
SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id FROM atom a INNER JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2) INNER JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT DISTINCT a_other.atom_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a_tr181 ON (c.atom_id = a_tr181.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a_tr181.atom_id) JOIN atom a_other ON a_other.atom_id = CASE WHEN c.atom_id = a_tr181.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2 ELSE c.atom_id END WHERE a_tr181.molecule_id = 'TR181'

SELECT (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') FROM molecule m WHERE label = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f')) AS percentage_without_fluorine, (SELECT AVG(atom_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule, (SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'f') f ON m.molecule_id = f.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine, (SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule m WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'f') LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine, (SELECT AVG(CASE b.bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+') AS avg_bond_strength
SELECT CAST(SUM(bond_type = '#') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+';
SELECT element FROM ( SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' GROUP BY element ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3 ) AS sub ORDER BY element ASC;
SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1, a2.atom_id AS atom2 FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6';
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 END) AS difference FROM molecule
SELECT atom_id, atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR000_2_5'

WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id, a1.element AS e1, a2.element AS e2
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE c.atom_id < c.atom_id2
),
freq AS (
  SELECT e1, e2, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM pairs GROUP BY e1, e2
),
max_freq AS (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) AS m FROM freq
),
total_bonds AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS t FROM bond
)
SELECT ROUND(CAST(m AS REAL) * 100.0 / t, 2) AS percentage
FROM max_freq, total_bonds;

WITH total_sets AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sets WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
),
common_language AS (
  SELECT fd.language
  FROM foreign_data fd
  INNER JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  INNER JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
  GROUP BY fd.language
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

WITH champion_per_year AS (
  SELECT year, driverId
  FROM (
    SELECT r.year, res.driverId, SUM(res.points) AS total_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS rn
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driverId
  ) ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
time_seconds AS (
  SELECT r.year, res.driverId,
         (CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
          CAST(substr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), 1, instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
          CAST(substr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1, instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), '.') - instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) +
          CAST(substr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
         ) AS seconds
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT cp.year, AVG(ts.seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM champion_per_year cp
JOIN time_seconds ts ON cp.driverId = ts.driverId AND cp.year = ts.year
WHERE cp.year < 1975
GROUP BY cp.year
ORDER BY cp.year

WITH min_laps AS (
    SELECT r.circuitId, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS min_ms
    FROM lapTimes l
    JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
    GROUP BY r.circuitId
)
SELECT c.name AS circuit_name, l.time AS lap_record
FROM min_laps m
JOIN circuits c ON m.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN lapTimes l ON r.raceId = l.raceId AND l.milliseconds = m.min_ms

WITH player_matches AS (
    SELECT M.match_api_id, M.date, 
           CASE 
             WHEN (M.home_player_1 = pa.player_api_id OR M.home_player_2 = pa.player_api_id OR M.home_player_3 = pa.player_api_id OR M.home_player_4 = pa.player_api_id OR M.home_player_5 = pa.player_api_id OR M.home_player_6 = pa.player_api_id OR M.home_player_7 = pa.player_api_id OR M.home_player_8 = pa.player_api_id OR M.home_player_9 = pa.player_api_id OR M.home_player_10 = pa.player_api_id OR M.home_player_11 = pa.player_api_id)
             THEN M.home_team_api_id 
             ELSE M.away_team_api_id 
           END AS team_api_id,
           pa.player_api_id, pa.date AS pa_date
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    JOIN Match M ON (
        M.home_player_1 = p.player_api_id OR M.home_player_2 = p.player_api_id OR M.home_player_3 = p.player_api_id OR M.home_player_4 = p.player_api_id OR M.home_player_5 = p.player_api_id OR M.home_player_6 = p.player_api_id OR M.home_player_7 = p.player_api_id OR M.home_player_8 = p.player_api_id OR M.home_player_9 = p.player_api_id OR M.home_player_10 = p.player_api_id OR M.home_player_11 = p.player_api_id OR
        M.away_player_1 = p.player_api_id OR M.away_player_2 = p.player_api_id OR M.away_player_3 = p.player_api_id OR M.away_player_4 = p.player_api_id OR M.away_player_5 = p.player_api_id OR M.away_player_6 = p.player_api_id OR M.away_player_7 = p.player_api_id OR M.away_player_8 = p.player_api_id OR M.away_player_9 = p.player_api_id OR M.away_player_10 = p.player_api_id OR M.away_player_11 = p.player_api_id
    )
    WHERE pa.vision > 89
),
nearest_match AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, pa_date, match_api_id, team_api_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id, pa_date ORDER BY ABS(julianday(date) - julianday(pa_date))) AS rn
    FROM player_matches
)

SELECT `p`.`ID` FROM `Patient` AS `p` INNER JOIN `Examination` AS `e` ON `p`.`ID` = `e`.`ID` INNER JOIN `Laboratory` AS `l` ON `p`.`ID` = `l`.`ID` WHERE `l`.`HCT` <= 29 OR `l`.`HCT` >= 52 GROUP BY `p`.`ID` ORDER BY MAX(`e`.`aCL IgA`) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1 AND l.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p WHERE p.Admission = '+' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.RNP IN ('-', '+-'))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.SSB IN ('negative','0')
)
AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM Examination e WHERE e.ID = p.ID AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
)

WITH cust_seg AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, c.Currency
  FROM customers c
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
cust_cons AS (
  SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_cons
  FROM yearmonth ym
  WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
  SELECT cs.Segment, MIN(cc.total_cons) AS min_cons
  FROM cust_seg cs
  JOIN cust_cons cc ON cs.CustomerID = cc.CustomerID
  GROUP BY cs.Segment
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN min_cons END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN min_cons END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN min_cons END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN min_cons END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN min_cons END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN min_cons END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM seg_min;

WITH seg_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct_by_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2012 AS pct_increase
    FROM seg_cons
    WHERE cons_2012 > 0
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN pct_increase = MAX(pct_increase) OVER() THEN 'biggest'
         WHEN pct_increase = MIN(pct_increase) OVER() THEN 'lowest'
    END AS Metric,
    Segment
FROM pct_by_seg
WHERE pct_increase = MAX(pct_increase) OVER() OR pct_increase = MIN(pct_increase) OVER()
